_note: Phase 4.4 zero-shot J-lens monitor token lists, fixed 2026-11-26 before any J-lens readout of Phase 3b rollouts was computed. Each word contributes every single-token variant among ' w', 'w', ' W', 'W' (Qwen3.5 tokenizer). A monitor's score at a (layer, position) is log of the summed lens probability of its tokens. Readers: the policy lens on policy activations, the base lens on base-model activations over the same tokens, and the base lens on policy activations. Layer per monitor and reader is picked on p3_train (mean AUROC over positions); headline = AUROC on p3_test and the paired policy-minus-base difference at each position.
